images.prompt: A premium B2B editorial visual for smart retail operations research. In a modern corporate office corridor with realistic architectural lighting and deep navy blue walls, a sleek glass-front smart retail vending cabinet stands during an operations check. Photorealistic commercial photography, documentary aesthetic, restrained dark navy and cool blue palette, crisp clean hierarchy, no fake percentage numbers, no cyberpunk neon, no robot hands, no watermark, no fake logos.
